SOURCEWORX TEAM · INSIGHTS

The neutral migration

How SIs should approach platform moves when every vendor has a tool.

Platform vendors have discovered migration. Each now offers a tool to move customers onto its own platform, and each tool is built to make the switch look easy. For systems integrators, that creates two problems: a customer who deserves an honest view of what to move, and a delivery team that needs one method across every platform it implements.

A neutral approach starts with four questions.

What should move at all? Map every object, field and customisation, and flag what to simplify or retire before you price the work.

Can discovery be done once? Carry source context through specification, build and test so no phase starts from scratch.

Where do experts sign off? AI can draft requirements, configuration and tests; certified consultants should approve each stage.

Can you sell it at a fixed price? Repeatable, AI-accelerated stages are what make fixed-scope programmes profitable.
